verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect to Stripe through a first-party MCP endpoint. The evidence is a single probe line about a Stripe-wide server and never shows that it exposes Treasury financial accounts, money movement, or transactions as tools. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server covers Treasury-specific objects and actions, details on setup, auth and available tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents operating Treasury via MCP.
